profile.headline: Web Developer at Salesforce
profile.summary:
I am proficient in a wide range of media that I have worked on professionally since 2004. I have extensive knowledge of graphic design, web design, and web development. I am also skilled in using many of today’s leading creative programs including Axure, and Adobe Master Suite programs: Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Dreamweaver, Flash, and Acrobat Pro.

I am experienced in industry standard web design programs, Content Management Systems (CMS), and coding languages including: HTML, XHTML, HTML5, CSS, CSS3, JavaScript, JQuery, PHP and MySQL. TextWrangler, Notepad++, and Wordpress. Additionally, I am skilled with User Interface (UI), User Experience (UX) Design an usability standards. 

Adobe Creative Suites CS6 and CC 
Adobe Master Suites CS6
Graphic Design:
Image Editing, Logo Design, Digital Art, Digital Illustration, Branding and Corporate Identity, Print Design, Print Ads, Display Ads

Web Design and Development:
CSS, HTML, XHTML, PHP, JQuery, Notepad++, Concept / Creative 
Design, UI, UX, MySQL, Database Admin, WordPress (CMS), (CMS), Hosting, Usability Standards and Testing, Mock-ups, Proposals, Internet Research, Comparative Product Analysis, Photoshop Coding, Social Media Marketing: Facebook, Twitter and LinkedIn, Browser Compatibility.
Photography:
Digital, Black & White, Portrait, Landscape, Photo Retouching and Color Correction.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Working within a team environment that consists of designers, digital marketers, and web developers.
•	Developing web pages and complying with deadlines.
•	Managing the Industries WEM Team
•	Weekly WEM Meetings/Checkin
•	Working on page layouts and deployments
•	Setting up Training Sessions for new hires 
•	Establishing QA Meetings 
•	Creating Banner Ads
•	Designing web pages for mobile phones and tablets
•	UX Testing
•	Building UX Journeys and working with internal teams to identify how to execute and launch a page 
        successfully

positions.title: Web Designer/Developer
positions.description:
Working within a team environment that consists of designers, digital marketers, and web developers.
•	Developing web pages and complying with deadlines.
•	Designing and developing mastheads for Demandware internal CMS system.
•	Working on page layouts and deployments
•	Designing forms for Demandware branding purposes
•	Creating Banner Ads
•	Designing web pages through for mobile phones
•	Designing and Developing email templates
•	UX Testing
•	Building UX Journeys 
•	Building UX Wireframes 
•	creating wireframes for web pages

positions.title: Front-End Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed CVS.com Health Insurance website
http://www.cvs.com/healthinsurance/index.html 
•	Developed website using HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery and   Bootstrap
•	UI/UX Development
•	Developed responsive mobile pages
•	Designed and Developed the UI for the Homepage Questionnaire 
•	Increasing usability by developing a more user centered design campaign

positions.title: E-Commerce Web Developer
positions.description: Racheles.com is an E-commerce website. I was initially brought on to design and develop the front-end. After completing it, I also remained on to complete the back-end as well. Therefore, at Racheles.com I was responsible for designing the logo, building out the UX and UI as well as developing the front-end and the back-end. The technology used on Racheles.com is HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, JQuery, Ajax, XML, PHP connected to a MySQL database.

positions.title: UX Designer (Contract)
positions.description:
Worked within a team environment that consist of Intergrated Marketers, Business Partners, Web Designers and Graphic Designers to develop web pages and comply with deadlines.

Designed web media which includes:
• Creating wireframes using Axure for Fidelity Digital Marketing Team.
• Developing web pages for Fidelity’s advisor website.
• Creating User Interface and User Exprience Designs that created a more visual appealing financial site.
• Increasing usability by developing a more user centered design campaign.

positions.title: Account Service Rep
positions.description:
General Responsibilities 

•	Communicate product details, brand stories, company policies and procedures in a manner that exemplifies professionalism and excellent customer service. 
•	Collect and log feedback pertaining to process improvements, product successes and failures, and dealer insights to the marketplace.
•	Offer product recommendations based on information collected, knowledge of products and the industry.
•	Maintain the integrity of order logistics and work to resolve bottlenecks in a timely manner.
•	Worked within a team environment to resolve issues with projects and complying with deadlines. Interacting with clients by way of e-mails and phone calls.

Designed print media which includes: 
•	Created layouts of posters, magazine covers, inserts, newsletters, logos, 
•	business cards, booklets, invitations, brochures, window clings and an array of various materials for New Balance Athletic Shoe.

educations.schoolName: The New England Institute of Art
